phase: Phase 1: Page B in the preview folder (by Wed 2026-11-18)
summary: Phase 1 task 1.8 fails. The page B calculations match D16, but preview.sh can write under docs/ and publish.ts misses added docs files. The PM manifest fallback has no unit test. Task 1.9 still cites an unreachable commit.
blocking_findings: A1 [Blocker] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:20: `--preview` accepts `<repo>/docs`. Line 29 then writes `docs/real-work.json` before any approval or drift check. Spec D21 and FR-7 forbid this write.

A2 [Blocker] review-a: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:78: The drift loop checks only paths recorded in `preview-base.json`. A new file added under `docs/` after the preview is not detected. Spec D21 requires a check of each current `docs/` file before any copy.
nonblocking_findings: A3 [Major] review-a: harness/model-guide-tests/input-check.test.ts:129: The changed-byte and wrong-size cases use `sha256:` and `size:` manifest lines. No test covers the PM sum line from commit `ef2d16f`. Both cases would pass if the new branch were absent or wrong.

A4 [Minor] review-a: measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:234: Task 1.9 cites `54836d0`, but no branch contains that commit. The reachable plan-record commit is `2131746`. The other Phase 1 SHAs exist in the audited range.
evidence: HEAD equaled audited_head_sha 213174652648b742af7a2adffce9ccb9e4f043b9. The audited diff was exactly 0a44cc9c417587e418899a97ac63f131a59fe2cd..213174652648b742af7a2adffce9ccb9e4f043b9.

The D16 calculations match the code at harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:180. The pass rate excludes no_result, the blocking rate uses results, few runs uses results, and the trend uses the last four ISO weeks.
The work-type code at harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:273 reads only runs, pass, and fail. Its rank uses the pass rate and result count.
The producer rank at harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:238 uses the lower blocking rate. The checker rank does not use blocking findings or ratings.
The merge at harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:49 removes only `[1m]` and the variant suffix. It keeps each provider separate.
The coverage block at harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:313 adds unknown and other runs. The real preview shows 1,798 runs, 50.6 percent, and 71.7 percent.
Commit ef2d16f at harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:146 parses the PM sum line. A changed byte fails the SHA check. A wrong manifest size fails the size check when the SHA still matches.
A changed file with a new size stops at the SHA check because SHA runs first. Every input refusal exits 2 before the output write.
No Phase 1 test uses the PM sum-line manifest. The two input refusal tests would pass with the fallback branch removed.
The test at harness/model-guide-tests/preview-gate.test.ts:213 uses the default preview path. It does not reject `--preview <repo>/docs`.
The test at harness/model-guide-tests/preview-gate.test.ts:246 changes an existing docs file. It does not add a new docs file after the preview.

The preview script calls real-work.ts at harness/model-guide/preview.sh:29 and the template at harness/model-guide/preview.sh:197. The publish script uses the preview files at harness/model-guide/publish.ts:66.
The build graph found no exported symbols or import callers in the two TypeScript scripts. The shell and plan wiring provide the callers.
The Phase 1 SHAs 563d33a, 0f0b2df, b42a234, f48787c, b38d577, f36ebb1, and 520e1b7 exist in the audited range. Commit 54836d0 resolves only as an unreachable object.
The three targeted test files exited 0. They reported 19, 6, and 7 passing tests. No digit-only count assertion or vacuous deliverable check was found.
The diff contains no change under docs/. The protected provenance, test, host, and credential paths also have no diff.
The route uses MiniMax. The audited Red and Green work used DeepSeek and Muse, so route parity holds.
